title: The Toss Effect in IPL
summary: 19 seasons of IPL toss data (2007/08–2026, 1,219 matches). Toss winner wins 52% of matches — barely above a coin flip. The real edge is the decision: bowl-first wins 54% vs bat-first 46%.
keyFindings: Toss winner wins 52% of IPL matches historically — barely above a coin flip across 18 seasons.
Bowl-first captains win 54% of matches; bat-first captains win only 46% across 1,146 captured toss decisions.
IPL 2026: bat-first win rate was below 50% of matches where the toss winner chose to bat.
Year-to-year volatility is high — some seasons see 60%+ toss-winner success, others below 45%.
provenance: Cricsheet CC BY 3.0 + CricketStudio IPL 2026 ball-by-ball · 18 seasons 2007/08–2025 + IPL 2026 · 1,219 matches
